purpose: Standalone disconnected-load P1.6 control-voltage test, not pump detection or a powered pump test
button: MSP S2 / P1.1; not the Zumo button
expected_behavior: A debounced S2 press starts about 3.003 seconds of steady P1.6 HIGH while red LED1 blinks at about 2 Hz, then both turn off. A second press cancels early; startup/held buttons cannot repeat the test.
expected_high_voltage: Approximately board VCC (3.3 V); a steady unloaded HIGH remains unverified
watchdog: Reset-mode ACLK watchdog about 1 second, serviced outside the pulse timer ISR
hardware_setup_confirmed_by_user: Zumo motor power OFF, pump and pump battery disconnected, MSP USB connected

installation.initial_usb_error: Windows descriptor request failure and TI No USB FET found; no programming occurred during that attempt
installation.usb_resolution: User changed the USB cable; MSP application COM13 and debug COM14 reappeared as TI 2047:0013
installation.postload_check_note: Current image program-verified, then timer and main-loop counters advanced over three startup samples including a 1.25-second run. P1.6 starts as GPIO output LOW.
installation.next_step: With power off remove the P1.6-to-MOSFET wire, then power only MSP USB and measure directly P1.6 to GND after one S2 press; leave the button alone for five seconds. Visible LED operation and steady unloaded HIGH remain pending. Restore supervisor before driving.

button_diagnosis.continuous_debug_capture_scope: The 45-second halt/resume trace did not observe a press and showed a counter restart. It is inconclusive as pulse/timing proof; debugger sampling can lengthen wall time.
button_diagnosis.original_no_visible_led_cause: Unresolved; do not equate an output latch or software pulse count with visible LED or unloaded meter validation.
